svg.text: Fig. 6 KV cache formats: three ways to store a 512-dim token, and what each costs in accuracy

text.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS','Segoe Print','KaiTi','STKaiti','Kaiti SC','AR PL UKai CN',cursive

svg.text: The kernels read every format as stored. 4-bit formats halve the bytes; how much they lose is decided when the cache is written, not in the kernel.

svg.text: Smaller blocks (16 vs 32 dims) and scales with a mantissa both help; outlier channels

text.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS','Segoe Print','KaiTi','STKaiti','Kaiti SC','AR PL UKai CN',cursive

svg.text: gain most because a 32-dim block shares its scale with the outlier.

text.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS','Segoe Print','KaiTi','STKaiti','Kaiti SC','AR PL UKai CN',cursive

svg.text: The kernel adds little on top: the exact modes nothing measurable, mxfp8 0.1-4.5%

text.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS','Segoe Print','KaiTi','STKaiti','Kaiti SC','AR PL UKai CN',cursive

svg.text: on the V4.1 FP4 cache. FP8 storage is 3.6x more accurate than V4.1 FP4.
